//: gf180mcuD @ 10 MHz. Ibex core (RegFileFF, ICache=0) -> pure std-cell, no RAM macros. Die 1000x1000um -> ~0.615 util. Pins East-facing: the functional interface (instr/data/irq/boot/hart/alerts/clk/rst) on East; tied-off buses spill to NE (crash_dump) and SE (scramble_*, ram_cfg_*) corners. All-East (672 pins on one edge) routes-congests at this size even though the slots fit, so the dead buses are distributed to relieve East routing. VERILOG_FILES/USE_SLANG injected by harden_block.sh.
//pdn: Uniform M2/M3 in-block PDN (scripts/block_pdn_m2m3.tcl): M1 rails -> sparse M2 risers -> M3(H), exposing ONLY Metal3; M4+M5 left entirely free (RT_MAX_LAYER=Metal3 keeps signals off them too) so the chip-top owns M4/M5 and the only handoff is top-M4 <-> block-M3 (Via3). No shared layer -> no duplicate-metal DRC. DIE grown 1000->1400 because capping routing at M3 (only M2+M3 for signal; ibex put ~25% of wire on M4/M5 at 1000um) needs ~2x area; util drops ~14%->~7%.
//grt: Routing capped at Metal3 leaves only M2+M3 for signal. First M2/M3 run hit GRT-0116 with only 4 overflow GCells at 35% usage (NOT capacity-bound) -> the global router's default 0.3 derating was too conservative for ibex's local pin hotspots. GRT_ADJUSTMENT 0.3->0.2 frees GR capacity to clear them; DRT still has room (35% global usage).
